_purpose: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for target facts. Every other place these values appear derives from here — nothing is hand-edited downstream. Created because the same fact was written in four independent places and nothing forced them to agree: the dissertation said 'C275F is Class B' while the frontend and backend both said 'A'. A checker catches that; a single source prevents it.
_authority: The dissertation (public/dissertation_revised.html) is authoritative where it speaks — it is the artifact under examination. Any value here that contradicts it is wrong by definition. bqp_class_source records the quote.
_consumers: scripts/laguna/verify_consistency.py (verifies all of the above agree)

_class_definitions._source: dissertation §06.i, verbatim: "Class A (quantum-necessary) — no classical path to chemical accuracy exists at the active-space boundary, so quantum simulation is the only route; Class B (quantum-advantaged) — classical methods are insufficient at the required accuracy, and quantum simulation supplies the advantage; and Class C (filtered out) — classical methods are sufficient, so the target is filtered out of the quantum pipeline as not quantum-relevant."
_class_definitions._ordering: The scale runs A (hardest, no classical path) -> B (classical insufficient, quantum advantaged) -> C (classical sufficient, filtered out). A is the quantum end; C is the classical end. Written down because this was inverted in discussion once — read as if C were the hard class — and nothing in the repo stated the direction explicitly.
_class_definitions._routing: Class A and B enter the quantum queue; Class C is filtered out of it.
_class_definitions._evidence_basis: The deciding physical quantity is the maximum von Neumann entanglement entropy (S_max) over bipartitions of the active space, not the electron count: DMRG's required bond dimension scales as M ~ e^(S_max) and its cost as M^3. Low S_max that saturates as the active space grows toward full site coverage (area law) is evidence FOR Class C — classically tractable. S_max that keeps climbing without saturating (volume law) is evidence toward B/A. FeMoco's CAS(113,76) was classically solved precisely because its S_max saturated at M=6000, despite 113 electrons — size is not the criterion.
_class_definitions.A: quantum-necessary — >18 active electrons and S_max above the threshold
_class_definitions.B: quantum-advantaged — >18 active electrons and S_max at or below the threshold
_class_definitions.C: filtered out — at or below 18 active electrons, whatever the entanglement
_class_definitions._rule: Two measured inputs: active electrons, and S_max measured over the site. <=18 active electrons -> C regardless of S_max (exact diagonalisation settles the space and is indifferent to entanglement, so S_max is not consulted). >18 active electrons -> B if S_max <= threshold, A if above it.
_class_definitions._evidence_rule: A class follows only from measurement. Electron count is known from the structure; S_max requires a run covering >=90% of the active site. Without it the entry carries a prior, not a classification, and bqp_class_source must say so. Electron count may motivate a prior; it cannot discharge one.
_class_definitions._threshold: S_HARD = 1.5, calibrated between N2 at equilibrium (0.42) and stretched (2.86). A policy of this pipeline, not a constant of nature. NOT replaced by a derived value: deriving one needs the M-vs-S relation, and calibration showed that relation is milder than the e^S bound it was assumed to follow (see _bound_is_not_a_rate). Both the prefactor and the exponent depend on the chemistry and on the size of the active space, so a value fitted on N2 at CAS(10,16) does not transfer to a 44-electron site.
_class_definitions._bound_is_not_a_rate: Measured, not assumed: an N2 stretch series at CAS(10,16)/cc-pVDZ, recording S_max and the bond dimension actually required for chemical accuracy at each geometry, returns a slope of 0.31 (R^2 = 0.82, five points, results/calibration/N2_CAS10-16_ccpvdz_2026-08-05.json). Across that series S_max rose by 1.45 while the requirement rose only 1.6x, where a slope of 1 demands 4.3x. The exponential relation is therefore an UPPER BOUND — it follows from assuming a flat entanglement spectrum, and real spectra decay, so fewer states are needed than the entropy alone implies. The direction holds and the dependence is still exponential; the rate is not e^S.

_class_granularity: A gene carries bqp_class only where the dissertation records it as having 'no single-residue anchor' (KEAP1, CDKN2A, STK11) — there the class is a property of the domain. Genes whose mutations genuinely differ (TP53) carry none, and their classes live under mutations.

KEAP1.bqp_class_source: dissertation §1: "One of the three KEAP1 target mutations (LOF, G333C, R320Q), classified Class B (quantum-advantaged)." Cited, but not measured: no S_max run meeting the Gateway's 90% site-coverage gate exists for KEAP1, so the class is a documented prior rather than a measurement.

ATRX.bqp_class_source: UNMEASURED PRIOR — the dissertation states no class for this gene, and no S_max run meeting the Gateway's 90% site-coverage gate exists for it. It is a hypothesis on the record, not a result.

ARID2_LOF.name: ARID2 p.Gln1118* (nonsense/truncating)
ARID2_LOF.bqp_class_source: UNMEASURED PRIOR, matching genes.ARID2 — no dissertation classification and no S_max run exists for this target.
ARID2_LOF.structure_caveat: UNRESOLVED, on two independent grounds. (1) p.Gln1118* is a nonsense/truncating mutation, not a point substitution — it removes ARID2's C-terminal C2H2 zinc-finger domains entirely (Li et al. 2011 Science 333:1157), so there is no single mutant residue for an active space to be built around, the same failure mode as KEAP1_LOF/RB1/ATRX frameshifts found in this session's NGS-report audit. (2) NO EXPERIMENTAL STRUCTURE OF ARID2 EXISTS AT ALL — confirmed by a dedicated search (2026-08-12): the cited AlphaFold-Q68CP9 is a computational prediction with no per-residue confidence (pLDDT) check performed, and the only real crystal/NMR structures findable under similar names (1RYU, 2CXY) belong to the related-but-distinct paralogs ARID1A (BAF250a) and ARID1B (BAF250b), not ARID2 (BAF200) itself — a name-similarity trap, not a stand-in. This is a different and weaker category of evidence than every other PDB citation in this file. generate_expansion_jw.py's own code comment for this target's 'mutant' compound (formamide) says explicitly: 'backbone only — truncation abolishes the sidechain/C-terminus' — the model acknowledges it is not representing a real mutant residue, only a generic proxy standing in for 'everything downstream is gone.' Checked 2026-08-12, same pass that added the STK11_F354L/KEAP1_R320Q findings.
ARID2_LOF.annual_patients_source: Not in dissertation § 01 Table 2 — ARID2 has no stated NSCLC patient-burden estimate anywhere in this codebase; do not infer one from the eleven-gene list, which does not include it.

SETD2_R1625C.name: SETD2 p.Arg1625Cys
SETD2_R1625C.bqp_class_source: SIZE PRIOR, NOT A MEASUREMENT — genes.SETD2 lists 30 active electrons (60 qubits) as a generic gene-level estimate; no residue-specific estimate or DMRG/S_max run exists for this mutation yet.
SETD2_R1625C.structure_caveat: VERIFIED — R1625 is the single most recurrent missense residue in SETD2 across COSMIC/cBioPortal, sitting inside the catalytic SET domain (residues 1550-1667). 5JJY (SETD2 catalytic domain bound to H3.3 K36M peptide, Yang et al. 2016) resolves residues 1434-1711 (AWS 1494-1549, SET 1550-1667, post-SET 1674-1690) — R1625 sits centrally within the SET domain, not near an edge. Additional structures of the same domain exist (5V21, 5V22, 6VDB). Found 2026-08-12 while auditing the eleven dissertation Table-2 genes beyond TP53/KEAP1/STK11 for real NSCLC point-mutation hotspots; SETD2 is the most frequently mutated epigenetic modifier in lung adenocarcinoma (~9%).
SETD2_R1625C.druggability_note: No approved or late-phase therapy. EZM0414 (oral SETD2 inhibitor) has FDA Fast Track but is Phase 1/1b, for relapsed/refractory DLBCL — not approved, not NSCLC. A WEE1-inhibitor (adavosertib) trial in SETD2-altered solid tumors showed no objective responses.
SETD2_R1625C.annual_patients_source: Not in dissertation § 01 Table 2 as a mutation-level figure — Table 2 gives SETD2 LOF collectively at ~5% NSCLC frequency / ~106,000 patients/yr, but that figure is not specific to the R1625C point mutation; do not attribute the gene-level number to this variant without checking what fraction of SETD2 LOF is R1625C specifically.

SMARCA4_R1192C.name: SMARCA4 p.Arg1192Cys
SMARCA4_R1192C.bqp_class_source: SIZE PRIOR, NOT A MEASUREMENT — genes.SMARCA4 lists 28 active electrons (56 qubits) as a generic gene-level estimate; no residue-specific estimate or DMRG/S_max run exists for this mutation.
SMARCA4_R1192C.structure_caveat: UNRESOLVED — confirmed directly against RCSB 2026-08-12 (Doron checked the 7VDT Sequence tab in person, chain A = Isoform 2 of Transcription activator BRG1/SMARCA4, UniProt P51532). The UNMODELED track shows a gray (unresolved) block beginning around residue ~1190 and continuing through the rest of the visible sequence — R1192 falls inside that unresolved region, not the modeled ATPase core. This reverses the earlier 'PLAUSIBLE, NOT FULLY VERIFIED' assessment, which had relied only on the general ~750-1250 ATPase-domain annotation rather than the deposited structure's own modeled range. FALLBACK CANDIDATE ALSO FAILED A CHECK: T910M (Thr910Met), the alternative ATPase-domain hotspot cited earlier, was checked against this same numbering — residue 910 in this chain (and in the aligned UniProt P51532 track) is Glycine, not Threonine. The 'T910M' label does not match this residue's actual identity here, so it cannot be confirmed as the same mutation without returning to the primary literature/COSMIC to verify the correct residue number — possibly a citation error in the earlier research pass (same failure mode as STK11 F354L's bogus 2QK7 citation), or an isoform-numbering offset between this isoform-2 chain and whatever numbering the original T910M report used. NOT resolved by inventing a nearby substitute (e.g. assuming T908, which is genuinely Threonine here, is 'probably what was meant') — that would repeat exactly the kind of unverified substitution this audit exists to catch. SMARCA4 currently has no usable sibling mutation the way STK11 has D194N; the gene is excluded from Table 1b entirely pending literature re-verification of a real, correctly-numbered hotspot.
SMARCA4_R1192C.druggability_note: No approved or late-phase therapy directly restoring/targeting mutant SMARCA4. Active synthetic-lethality approach: PRT3789 (SMARCA2 degrader, exploiting SMARCA4/SMARCA2 paralog dependency) is in Phase 1/2 trials — not approved.
SMARCA4_R1192C.annual_patients_source: Not in dissertation § 01 Table 2 as a mutation-level figure — Table 2 gives SMARCA4 LOF collectively at ~6% NSCLC frequency / ~127,000 patients/yr, not specific to R1192C; more than half of SMARCA4 alterations in NSCLC are missense generally, but frank protein-loss cases are still truncating-dominated (81% vs 0% for missense per functional studies) — do not read the gene-level patient count as this variant's own burden.

U2AF1_S34F.name: U2AF1 p.Ser34Phe
U2AF1_S34F.bqp_class_source: NOT CLASSIFIED — deliberately left unclassified rather than given a size proxy. See structure_caveat for why this is excluded.
U2AF1_S34F.structure_caveat: UNRESOLVED — no confirmed experimental structure (crystal, NMR, or cryo-EM) of human U2AF1 resolves residue 34. The only human U2AF1 crystal structure found (1JMT, core U2AF65/U2AF35 heterodimer) covers residues 43-146 only (the UHM domain) — residue 34 sits in the N-terminal zinc finger (ZnF1, ~residues 14-41), outside that construct entirely. Zinc-finger structures exist only for the fission-yeast homolog, not sequence-identical at this position. Human spliceosome cryo-EM complexes were not confirmed to model U2AF1's ZnF1, which is often flexible/disordered in those maps. Despite being a real, well-documented, NSCLC-recurrent point mutation (~81% of U2AF1 mutations in LUAD are S34F specifically, ~3% of all LUAD, per cBioPortal/TRACERx), this target fails the structural-coverage gate the same way KEAP1_R320Q and STK11_F354L did. Found 2026-08-12; direct RCSB/EBI verification was blocked by network egress in this session and should be re-attempted before treating this as final.
U2AF1_S34F.druggability_note: Not druggable. Splicing modulators (sudemycins, H3B-8800) show preclinical/early-clinical selectivity toward U2AF1-S34F cells; H3B-8800 Phase I (MDS/AML/CMML) showed no CR/PR. No approved or late-phase agent, none NSCLC-specific.
U2AF1_S34F.annual_patients_source: Not in dissertation § 01 Table 2 as a split figure — Table 2 gives 'U2AF1 S34F/Y' combined at ~3% NSCLC frequency / ~64,000 patients/yr; S34F is reported as the dominant ~80% of that combined figure, S34Y the remaining ~20%, per the literature that first characterized the split in MDS.

ARID1A_R1020S.name: ARID1A p.Arg1020Ser
ARID1A_R1020S.bqp_class_source: SIZE PRIOR, NOT A MEASUREMENT — genes.ARID1A lists 28 active electrons (56 qubits) as a generic gene-level estimate; no residue-specific estimate or DMRG/S_max run exists for this mutation.
ARID1A_R1020S.structure_caveat: VERIFIED — 1RYU (NMR solution structure of the ARID/DNA-binding domain) resolves residues ~1000-1119, the only experimentally-solved fragment of ARID1A's 2285-residue length (the rest is largely intrinsically disordered, unlike the ARID domain). R1020 sits within that resolved span, alongside a cluster of related hotspots (M1022K, K1047Q, G1063V, A1089T) also inside it. Checked 2026-08-12.
ARID1A_R1020S.nsclc_relevance: * NOT AN NSCLC TARGET — flagged explicitly so this entry is never read as lung-relevant. This ARID-domain missense cluster is reported from pan-TCGA data in hepatocellular, cutaneous (skin), uterine, and gastric (stomach) carcinomas — not lung. ARID1A's own NSCLC-specific alterations (Q515*, Q1519*) are themselves nonsense/truncating, same failure mode as ARID2, and are NOT this entry. Included here only because the user asked to see it on structural grounds alone, independent of cancer type.
ARID1A_R1020S.druggability_note: No direct-restoration small molecule for ARID1A LOF. Synthetic-lethality approach: EZH2 inhibition (tazemetostat) in ARID1A-deficient tumors, active trials (e.g. NCT05023655) — deficiency-based, not mutation-specific, not approved for this variant.
ARID1A_R1020S.annual_patients_source: No NSCLC patient-burden figure applies — this variant is not observed in lung cancer in the literature reviewed. Dissertation Table 2's 'ARID1A LOF ~106,000/yr' figure is for lung-cancer LOF generally (truncating-dominated) and must not be attributed to R1020S.
